draw-hint: Drag on the picture to add a mask. Drag a mask to move it and its corners to resize it. With a mask selected, the arrow keys move it by 1 %, Shift with the arrow keys resizes it, and Delete removes it.
error-occlusion-bad-label: Give every mask a label of up to 200 characters
error-occlusion-invalid: The masks could not be read. Remove them and draw them again
error-occlusion-no-masks: Add at least one mask to the picture
error-occlusion-out-of-bounds: A mask is outside the picture
error-occlusion-too-many-masks: A picture can have at most 20 masks
error-occlusion-too-small: A mask is too small: make it at least 2 % of the picture each way
export-skipped-occlusion_one: {{count}} picture-occlusion card was left out. Export as JSON to keep it.
export-skipped-occlusion_other: {{count}} picture-occlusion cards were left out. Export as JSON to keep them.
mode-hide-all-hint: Every mask is covered, and one is asked. The others stay covered after the answer.
mode-hide-one-hint: Only the mask being asked is covered; the rest of the picture shows.
no-masks: No masks yet. Drag on the picture, or press Add mask.
note-hint: Shown after the answer is revealed. One card is made for each mask.
picture-first: Add the picture first: the masks are drawn over it.
reason-invalid-occlusion: The masks are missing, outside the picture, too small or have no label
surface-label: Picture with masks. Select a mask in the list, or drag on the picture to add one.
surface-label-selected: Picture with masks. Mask {{n}} of {{of}} is selected: arrow keys move it, Shift with the arrow keys resizes it, Delete removes it.
